The nav bar 'Documents' tab never becomes active and no document detail is shown, despite the node's target being 'document.detail'.

evidence: Documents, Knowledge Graph, and Favorites nav tabs all present and each activates its respective view (documents.view, graph.view, favorites.view) when clicked.

issue: Favorites view inherits Documents module filter, hiding favorited docs outside that module
actual: Favorites are retained after reload (count stayed at 2) and their markers survive sort/filter changes in Documents. However, after setting the Documents module filter to 'AUTH' and switching to Favorites, only 'JWT Authentication' (AUTH module) was shown while 'REST API Design Guidelines' (API module, also favorited) was hidden, even though the Favorites count badge correctly showed 2. localStorage confirms selectedModule='auth' is a shared global filter applied to the Favorites list too, violating the requirement that Favorites must expose every favorited document regardless of the Documents module filter.
